title: Construction of By-pass and Diversion Roads, Cdoc, Iligan City Hinterland Road (Jct. Cdo Camp Kibaritan Road, Dominorog Road, Dansolihon, Jct. Ibr, Rogongon, Iligan City) Alternate Road, Barangay…
description: CONSTRUCTION OF BY-PASS AND DIVERSION ROADS, CDOC-ILIGAN CITY HINTERLAND ROAD (JCT. CDO CAMP KIBARITAN ROAD-DOMINOROG ROAD, DANSOLIHON-JCT. IBR, ROGONGON, ILIGAN CITY) ALTERNATE ROAD, BARANGAY ROGONGON SECTION, ILIGAN CITY
colour_meaning: Look first: an official warning record, or two signs of risk together.

reasons.title: A bidder's name matches the government blacklist
reasons.detail: M. MONTESCLAROS ENTERPRISES, INC.: documented link to Niel Tupas Sr. (Governor of Iloilo (deceased)): PCIJ reported that two of the firm's seven stockholders are in-laws of the late Iloilo governor. [reported, 2018-09; as reported]
reasons.evidence: Official record (GPPB blacklist, via OpenSanctions). A name match is not proof that it is the same firm.
checks: Open the blacklist entry and compare the licence (PCAB) number, address and company type with the bidder's.
Check that the debarment period covers the bid date; debarments expire.
Check whether the matched firm won or lost; a losing bidder matters less once the contract is awarded.

reasons.title: A bidder has a reported link to an official or investigation
reasons.detail: M. MONTESCLAROS ENTERPRISES, INC.: documented link to Niel Tupas Sr. (Governor of Iloilo (deceased)): PCIJ reported that two of the firm's seven stockholders are in-laws of the late Iloilo governor. [reported, 2018-09; as reported]
reasons.evidence: From the team's register of company–person links reported in the news or hearings. Reported, not proven.
checks: Read the source article; confirm the link is stated there, not inferred.
Look for an official document (SEC filing, COA report, Ombudsman complaint) that confirms it.

reasons.title: A bidder had a contract terminated before
reasons.detail: M. Montesclaros Enterprises, Inc.: 1 of 597 earlier road contracts terminated
reasons.evidence: In past contracts, a winner with an earlier termination had about 2.1 times the odds of another; this held on 2023–2025 data.
checks: Open the terminated contracts listed under Bidders and see why they ended (COA report, DPWH order).
Check whether the firm with the termination record is the winner.

reasons.title: Very fast award after bid opening
reasons.detail: Award made 3 days after the bid deadline (past road contracts awarded this fast had about twice the odds of termination)
reasons.evidence: Awards within 8 days of bid opening had about 2.1 times the odds of termination.
checks: Compare the bid-opening date with the Notice of Award date.
Ask whether post-qualification (checking the winner's documents and capacity) could be done that fast.

reasons.title: The winner's other projects drew citizen reports
reasons.detail: EQUI-PARCO CONSTRUCTION COMPANY has 6 other DPWH projects reported by citizens (ghost/defective/unfinished tags)
reasons.evidence: A contractor whose other roads drew 2+ citizen reports had about 4.5 times the odds of a report.
checks: Open the winner's reported projects on the DPWH Transparency Portal and read what citizens reported.
Plan a site visit or ask a local monitor (Bisto Proyekto, TAPAT) to look once work starts.

reasons.title: Citizen inspectors rated the winner's other work unsatisfactory
reasons.detail: EQUI-PARCO CONSTRUCTION COMPANY has 1 project(s) rated unsatisfactory by Bisto citizen site inspectors
more: EQUI-PARCO CONSTRUCTION COMPANY has 1 project(s) rated unsatisfactory by Bisto citizen site inspectors
reasons.evidence: From Bisto Proyekto volunteer site inspections.
checks: Open the inspections of the winner's other projects on bisto.ph.
